### A genuine residence theorem for corrected open graph interfaces

For an open graph interface with signed unbounded gradients, the weak geometric touch interaction, and an admissible small area field, the construction gives a polynomial physical gap and a killed residence bound. It uses the geometric cancellation in Posta’s corrected SOS analysis while retaining the interaction in the conditional laws. 

The passage from transport energy to residence includes an explicit norm comparison:
\[
\lambda_{\rm phys}
\ge
\left[
g^{-1}+\frac{\rho_{\rm lift}(d+1)}{\lambda_{\rm macro}}
\right]^{-1}.
\]
This establishes the required distinction between an energy estimate and a residence certificate.

Its scope is an open graph interface. Fixed closure constraints and unrestricted overhangs are not covered.
